g.inkscape:label: Torso Front
g.data-note: the drawn three-quarter chest; a strike swaps it for torso_open / torso_profile

g.inkscape:label: Torso Front - Open (coil)
g.data-note: the chest turned TO the camera for a wind-up: the whole shell faces us, the light sits mid-chest

g.inkscape:label: Torso Front - Profile (strike)
g.data-note: the chest turned toward the TARGET as a strike lands: the front plate narrows onto its leading edge and the light turns with it

g.inkscape:label: Energy Blade
g.data-note: hidden unless an attack keys blade_vis; the hilt sits under the fist (near_hand z48). Drawn pointing +x (0 deg) so it fits the canvas; strikes key the blade's world direction and the solver turns the wrist to match

g.inkscape:label: Energy Blade - Far Hand
g.data-note: the same blade in the FAR hand: the robot holds it in one hand, and from its other side (the left-facing rows) that hand is the far one. Drawn pointing -x (180 deg) so it fits the canvas; under the fist (far_hand z8) like the near blade under its fist

g.inkscape:label: Hand - Near
g.data-note: screen-left hand base + finger line details

g.inkscape:label: Complete Boot / Foot - Far
g.data-note: complete rigid boot, sole, and toe artwork

g.inkscape:label: Complete Boot / Foot - Near
g.data-note: complete rigid boot, sole, and toe artwork

g.inkscape:label: Head Side (ear cup + antenna)
g.data-note: the robot's ONE ear cup, on the camera-side ear when facing right. It and antenna_near are one assembly (near_ear_vis): from the robot's other side there is no ear piece at all

g.inkscape:label: Antenna - Near Ear
g.data-note: the antenna on the ear facing the camera; its root sits inside the ear cup (head_side, drawn over it)

g.inkscape:label: Antenna - Far Ear
g.data-note: the SAME antenna seen from the robot's other side: on the far ear, which in this three-quarter view projects toward the face, so it rises from BEHIND the shell there and only its top shows. Drawn when the camera sees the other side of the head: the left-facing view, or a head looking back

g.inkscape:label: Face - Fierce
g.data-note: determined eyes for a cut: the tops slant down toward each other

g.inkscape:label: Face - Strain
g.data-note: squeezed chevron eyes: a smash held, a heave
